requirements.statement: A person can sign up for an account and sign in, getting a private persistent place for their todos

criteria.must: A new person can create their own account without an admin provisioning it first
A person can sign in after creating an account
Sign-up completes without an email verification step
An unauthenticated visitor cannot view or add todos

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can add a new todo item

criteria.must: A signed-in user can add a new todo item by entering text
A newly added todo item appears in the user's list as not done

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can see their list of todo items, both outstanding and completed, oldest first

criteria.must: A signed-in user sees only the todo items they themselves created
The list shows both pending and completed items together, with completed ones visibly distinguished
Todo items are listed oldest-first, in the order they were added
A user's todo list persists and is still present after signing out and back in

requirements.statement: A signed-in user can mark one of their todo items as done

criteria.must: A signed-in user can mark a pending todo item as done
A todo item marked done stays saved as done after a page reload

requirements.statement: There is no way to edit or delete a todo item

criteria.must: The app offers no control to edit an existing todo item's text
The app offers no control to delete a todo item, pending or done
